changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Create system.mail_settings, the single-row SMTP configuration an admin edits in Configurações → E-mail (issue #536). It lives apart from system.configurations because that table returns every value to the client and rejects blank values, while the SMTP password must never leave the server and the username may be blank. The password is stored as AES-256-GCM ciphertext. The row starts disabled with every server field null.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE system.mail_settings ( id SMALLINT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, host TEXT, port INT, security TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'STARTTLS' CHECK (security IN ('NONE', 'STARTTLS', 'SSL_TLS')), username TEXT, password_ciphertext TEXT, from_address TEXT, from_name TEXT, public_url TEXT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL );
INSERT INTO system.mail_settings (id, enabled, updated_at) VALUES (1, false, now());
